commerce.truth_note: Clicks are traffic, not revenue. Only confirmed commission minus reversals counts as affiliate revenue.

providers.note: Official Browse API + eBay Partner Network affiliate tracking are supported by the architecture, but credentials/campaign ID are not configured in this environment.

Amazon Associates is official. New catalog integrations should target the supported Creators API rather than starting new work on deprecated PA-API 5. Account/program eligibility and disclosure requirements must be satisfied before activation.
Official affiliate program supports deal/coupon/community promotion in supported markets. Rewards and qualifying actions vary by market, so rates must come from the approved account/dashboard.
Official affiliate program exists. No live product-feed/API adapter is configured, so product inventory and commission rates must not be fabricated.
Official Affiliates and Creator Collective programs exist. Product promotion remains manual until a compliant feed/API and attribution workflow is verified for this project.
Walmart operates an official affiliate program and uses Impact as its affiliate service provider. Activation stays manual until the approved account and tracking workflow are connected.
TikTok Shop has an official commission-based affiliate model, but seller/creator/product eligibility rules apply by market. Do not assume catalog access or eligibility.
Official partner marketplace connects publishers with thousands of brands and a large product marketplace. Treat it as a multi-brand provider layer, not a single retailer.
Official publisher network provides access to global advertiser relationships and tracked affiliate conversion programs. Brand-level approvals and terms still apply.
Official publisher network provides advertiser discovery, commission details and tracked links after publisher approval. Individual advertiser program approval may still be required.
No production adapter is enabled until a current official API/feed and affiliate attribution path is independently verified for this project.

checkout.rule: A provider may supply comparison and product intelligence without being allowed to complete a purchase. A Buy action is enabled only after an official on-site checkout flow is independently verified and approved.

eBay.note: eBay Order API can support complete on-site checkout, but production checkout is Limited Release and requires separate Buy API approval, EPN approval, contracts, and UX review.

impact.com.note: Treat current Impact integration as affiliate/provider checkout unless a specific merchant contract exposes an approved on-site order API.

Amazon.note: Creators/Associates product discovery does not by itself authorize HUNT DEAL to process the retailer payment.

truth_note: Only TEST/SELL candidates appear publicly. Empty storefronts stay empty rather than showing fabricated products. HUNT DEAL is ONSITE_FIRST: comparison data may come from external providers, but a purchase action stays disabled until an approved on-site checkout integration exists.
